profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap way in Santa Clara County, California, is a second record, alongside a companion way at the same general location, tagged with the operator name "Stack Infrastructure" but no facility code. As with its companion record, this could plausibly represent a duplicate map entry for STACK's documented SVY02 campus in Santa Clara (48 megawatts, formerly Memorex's headquarters), or could represent an undisclosed third Silicon Valley campus implied by STACK's own stated aggregate figures, which describe "3 campuses across 97 acres" totaling 150 megawatts even though only two campuses, SVY01 and SVY02, are individually named and detailed on STACK's site, together totaling 148 megawatts. STACK, headquartered in Denver, Colorado, operates roughly 8.5 gigawatts of capacity built or under development across 24 global markets company-wide. Rather than assign an unconfirmed facility code or capacity figure to this record, this entry documents the ambiguity honestly, consistent with the treatment of its companion record, and records only the confirmed market-level context pending further research that could resolve the coordinate match against STACK's own published campus locations.

reading.body:
This facility is one of four buildings on Stack Infrastructure's San Jose campus, SVY01, which the operator publishes at 100 MW total across 1,030,000 square feet of data hall space on 19 acres. The specific building represented by this registry row cannot be determined from the operator's published pages; it is most plausibly one of four structures ranging from 140,000 to 350,000 square feet each. No individual building capacity is published.

Stack Infrastructure has not published a cooling or IT load specification for this facility. If IT load runs at 40 kW per rack, a common density for AI training clusters, the campus's 100 MW would support roughly 2,500 racks; the actual density at this site is not disclosed. No certifications or compliance specifications are published for this campus.

This campus sits in California, which has 103 mapped data center facilities and 365 MW of published capacity across 11 facilities. The SVY01 campus ranks twelfth among California facilities for published capacity. Stack Infrastructure operates three separate campuses in Silicon Valley totaling 150 MW; this row covers one of them and cannot be individually ranked against other state facilities.
